claims.claim: Grove describes an allocation into tokenized JAAA and economic exposure through tokens; Anemoy describes a managed CLO portfolio, fund structure and subscriptions/redemptions.

claims.label: fund_share
claims.claim: These retained public descriptions do not specify the proportional beneficial/economic share right required by R-fund_share for the instrument being classified, nor bind Grove capital-provider claims to that right. A managed-fund name and an investment allocation alone do not close this predicate.

claims.label: fund_share
claims.claim: The underlying JAAA investment and a direct instrument offered by Grove must remain distinct. Proposed not_evidenced records this bounded rights/scope gap; it does not deny that JAAA or another Grove exposure can carry fund-share rights.

qualifications: Two substantive primary bodies were retained: Grove's article and Anemoy's fund page. Their commercial relationship means different hostnames alone do not establish independent corroboration.

The Grove body carries article content in JSON-encoded React flight data; literal data were decoded for inspection without executing scripts. The initially empty visible-main extraction is retained and is not falsely described as missing source content.

The retained Anemoy page records its own publication metadata. Neither body establishes the precise historical offering documents, share class, token/share ratio, register of members or Grove depositor interface.

A secondary governance discussion discovered possible offering-document details but no primary governing instrument was recovered from it; those secondary assertions are not adjudication evidence here.

The tokenized Anemoy JAAA fund is not silently equated with the US-listed JAAA ETF or with underlying CLO tranches. No legal guarantee, bankruptcy-remoteness claim, NAV accuracy, redemption timing or live balance was verified.
next_step: Retrieve issuer-authored governing share/portfolio terms and bind the exact instrument boundary—Grove's held asset versus a claim issued to its capital provider—before proposing a proportional fund_share finding. Keep this packet unresolved meanwhile.
